audience: real-estate agents in Latin America who run listings, clients and agenda tasks in Wasi

useCases.title: Search listings for sale or rent
useCases.text: Search the properties with filters for sale, rent, type, location, price and bedrooms. Open one property for its full detail.

useCases.title: Read a client and the properties linked to it
useCases.text: Read one client's contact details, status and type. List the properties linked to that client, with the relation of each.

useCases.title: Review the agenda for the week
useCases.text: List the agenda tasks assigned between two dates, such as the calls and meetings of the week. Read one task, or list the users to see who owns it.

useCases.title: Add a new client from a lead
useCases.text: Search the clients first, to see whether the lead already exists. Then create the client with the Wasi field names, such as first_name.

useCases.title: Link a client to a property
useCases.text: Link a client to a property with a relation type, such as owner or buyer. The link changes the live CRM data of the account.

useCases.title: Create a follow-up task for an agent
useCases.text: Create an agenda task for a user and a client, with the Wasi field names such as subject, date and id_user. The task changes the live account data.
